title: Holland Scholarship
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and participating institutions (Nuffic)
description: Scholarship for international students from outside the European Economic Area applying for a bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch research university or university of applied sciences. Applications are made directly to the institution.
amount: EUR 5,000 in the first year of study (one-off, not a full scholarship)

deadlines.term: 2027-2028 (deadline varies by institution, typically 1 Feb or 1 May)

title: Orange Tulip Scholarship
provider: Nuffic Neso country offices and participating Dutch institutions
description: Country-linked scholarship programme coordinated by Nuffic Neso offices for students from selected countries, offered as a set of institution-specific awards ranging from partial tuition waivers to full tuition plus living costs.
amount: Partial tuition waiver up to full tuition plus living costs (varies by institution)

title: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship
description: Merit-based scholarship for a limited number of excellent students from outside the EEA admitted to a master's programme at the University of Amsterdam.
amount: EUR 3,000 up to EUR 25,000, in some cases combined with a tuition waiver

title: Radboud Scholarship Programme
description: Scholarship for talented non-EEA students admitted to an eligible English-taught master's programme at Radboud University, reducing tuition to the statutory (EEA) rate and adding a contribution to living costs.
amount: Tuition reduced to the EEA statutory fee plus an allowance towards living costs, visa and insurance

title: University of Twente Scholarship (UTS)
description: Scholarship for excellent students from both EU/EEA and non-EU/EEA countries applying for a graduate degree programme at the University of Twente.
amount: EUR 6,000 to EUR 25,000 for one year (renewable for a second year on performance)

title: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
description: Merit scholarship for outstanding non-EU/EEA students enrolling in a master's programme at Leiden University.
amount: EUR 10,000, EUR 15,000 or the full tuition fee minus the statutory fee

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Netherlands-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, many coordinated by or including Dutch institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
